producer_report.summary: Ceiling raised 8 to 16; athena.toml max_concurrency set to 12 with updated comment. Each drain Report now has group_sizes (items that began per group, in order, unreached groups absent), printed as a 'group sizes' line with mean; nothing printed when no group worked. Tests added for config (16 ok, 17 refused), drain (sizes [2,1], unreached group absent, [1,1,1] serial) and display exact string. Built note in the design doc and a CHANGELOG entry added.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs declares MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING as 16, and its doc comments and the athena.toml comment ('the schema allows 1 to 8') say 1 to 16.
criteria_check.evidence: Constant now 16; field docs reference the constant ('from 1 to [`MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING`]'), error text 'from 1 to {CEILING}'; athena.toml comment now says 1 to 16. Read the edited lines.

criteria_check.criterion: athena.toml [parallel] max_concurrency is 12 (the design's section 7.2 starting value), with its comment updated; athena.toml is listed as a deliverable for this reason.
criteria_check.evidence: athena.toml has max_concurrency = 12 with updated comment; config test asserts 12 and passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: tests show max_concurrency = 16 and max_in_flight = 16 validate, and 17 (ceiling + 1) is refused with the 'from 1 to 16' error.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-data config: the_ceiling_is_sixteen_and_the_shipped_start_is_twelve passes: max_concurrency 16 ok, 17 error contains 'from 1 to 16'; max_in_flight 16 ok, 17 refused naming max_in_flight (that error text has no range).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`: a test drains a plan with groups of different sizes (e.g. two items disjoint in one group, one item alone in another) and asserts the Report's new group-size record lists the size of each group the batch worked, in order, and that groups not reached are not recorded.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain group: group_sizes == [2,1] for a,b disjoint + c depending on a; with budget 2.5 only [2] recorded while plan_groups has 2 groups; bound 1 gives [1,1,1]. All pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli` display tests: the end-of-run lines print the group sizes and their mean (an exact expected string asserted), and print nothing misleading when no group was worked.
criteria_check.evidence: display::tests assert exactly "group sizes 2, 1 (mean 1.5, 2 groups worked)\n" and that an empty record gives None (no line); display::drain calls it. Ran cargo test -p athena-cli --lib group_sizes: pass.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/agent-and-build-slots.md step 6 gets a short Built note stating the ceiling, the starting value 12, what is recorded, and what was not measured (peak in-flight and the low-disk count are read after real drains); CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
criteria_check.evidence: Built note added under step 6 and an Unreleased/Added entry in CHANGELOG.md; policy scan passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` from the repository root: all pass with no new warnings.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks (I ran cargo fmt --all and clippy on athena-cli/athena-data with -D warnings, clean; did not run the full suite).

open_issues: Did not run the full cargo test suite; left to Athena's checks.
docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and async-drain.md still say the schema allows 1 to 8 (historical design text, not edited).
mistakes: First version recorded group size at dispatch, which counted a group whose items were all held back by the budget; fixed to count items that began.
First tests assumed a 'from 1 to 16' message for max_in_flight and a target-rating stop; both corrected after running.
learnings: A wave is dispatched to run() even when the budget or job limit then stops every item in it, so counting at dispatch overcounts; State.begun marks items that actually started.
The [drain.pipeline] max_in_flight error text has no range ('is out of range'); only the [parallel] error says 'from 1 to N'.
Rebasing stub in tests/drain.rs is the concurrent-capable stub; a budget of 2.5 stops it before a third job.
